advancements.tlm_pet.root.title: The Most Precious Luggage
advancements.tlm_pet.root.description: Bring her along, to any world
advancements.tlm_pet.first_maid.title: First Companion
advancements.tlm_pet.first_maid.descript: Create your first maid at the altar
advancements.tlm_pet.she_chose_you.title: She Chose You
advancements.tlm_pet.she_chose_you.descr: Not merely created - she decided on you. Only once in a lifetime
advancements.tlm_pet.reunion.title: Reunion Across Worlds
advancements.tlm_pet.reunion.description: She crossed the gap between worlds and stands before you again
advancements.tlm_pet.found_her.title: Met Her in the Wild
advancements.tlm_pet.found_her.descripti: Find and tame a maid in a pillager outpost
advancements.tlm_pet.first_carry.title: First Extraction
advancements.tlm_pet.first_carry.descrip: Extract her data into your luggage. From now on she can follow you anywhere
advancements.tlm_pet.first_reunion.title: First Recall
advancements.tlm_pet.first_reunion.descr: Awaken her again in a brand new world
advancements.tlm_pet.three_worlds.title: Three Worlds
advancements.tlm_pet.three_worlds.descri: Travel through three different worlds together
advancements.tlm_pet.memory_keeper.title: Keeper of Memories
advancements.tlm_pet.memory_keeper.descr: Let her memories settle into a complete record of your adventures
advancements.tlm_pet.bond_preserved.desc: Across worlds, the bond remains at its peak
advancements.tlm_pet.let_go.title: Higanbana Blooms
advancements.tlm_pet.let_go.description: Formally part with her at the altar. Not a loss - a farewell you chose yourself
item.tlm_pet.bond_core.lore: Heart of the Recall Bell. Proof that you once packed her into your luggage.
item.tlm_pet.homing_jade.lore: Carried in your inventory, the bell's cooldown drops from 30s to 5s. Never consumed.
item.tlm_pet.tracking_charm.lore: Used to locate where she is.
item.tlm_pet.sanzu_key.lore: Key to the Sanzu River. Lets a recall keep the target world's coordinate memory.
item.tlm_pet.memory_shard.lore: Lets the pet side hold more of her adventure memories.
item.tlm_pet.undying_bond.lore: Proof of a maxed bond. Still maxed after crossing worlds.
item.tlm_pet.higanbana_keepsake.lore: The only proof she existed. It has no use - and needs none.
item.tlm_pet.recall_bell.lore: Calls her back from the pet into your world. 30s cooldown.
item.tlm_pet.recall_bell.lore_jade: With a Homing Jade in your inventory, the cooldown drops to 5s.
message.tlm_pet.recall.no_maid: She is not with you. Let the pet take her data first, so the bell has someone to answer.
message.tlm_pet.recall.already_here: She is already here. Use the Servant Bell if you want her to come from afar.
message.tlm_pet.recall.elsewhere: She is still in "%s". Put her away with the pet first, then bring her here.
message.tlm_pet.recall.film: She is a film roll now - decide what to do with that roll first. A bell cannot call back a film.
message.tlm_pet.recall.payload_missing: Her data cannot be found (%s...). Check whether she is still in the pet.
message.tlm_pet.recall.payload_broken: Her data file cannot be read; it may be corrupted. The original file is still there: %s
message.tlm_pet.release.no_maid: You do not have her; the ritual has no one to address.
message.tlm_pet.release.not_film_held: She is not in a film roll. Put her into a film first, then talk about farewell.
message.tlm_pet.release.archive_failed: Archiving her data failed; the ritual was aborted and nothing was changed.
message.tlm_pet.release.failed: The ritual could not proceed; nothing was changed. Please check the log.
message.tlm_pet.release.success: The higanbana has bloomed. Every place she went with you, you remember.
